MAYOR’S FUND SUBCOMMITTEE AGENDA
  MONDAY, JUNE 8, 2026
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM

James Howat, Member  Leanna Noble, Member
Julie Lie, Member  Stephen Wood, Member

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments
  to homelessservicesadmin@longbeach.gov

  For information on how to participate in this meeting, please visit:
  https://www.longbeach.gov/homelessness/volunteer-donate-and-get-involved/#committee

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55319  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Homeless Services Mayor’s Fund
  Subcommittee meeting of Monday, January 12, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55320  Recommendation to receive and file the Mayor’s Fund Balance Update from the
  Health Department.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55317  Recommendation to review and if appropriate approve the Mayor’s Fund
  Subcommittee grant application submitted by Disabled Resources Center, Inc. for
  funding in the amount of $10,000.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55322  Recommendation to review and if appropriate approve the Mayor’s Fund
  Subcommittee grant application submitted by His Little Feet for funding in the
  amount of $10,000.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-55323  Recommendation to review and if appropriate approve the Mayor’s Fund
  Subcommittee grant application submitted by Urban Social Service and Advocacy
  for funding in the amount of $10,000.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-55456  Recommendation to review the proposed $50,000 budget plan for the Mayor's
  Fund Pilot Hygiene Project and discuss submission to the City Manager and City
  Council, with funding provided through the Mayor's Fund.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-55318  Recommendation to review and discuss the current process for final one-page
  summaries of Mayor’s Fund grant recipients.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-55447  Recommendation to review and discuss the current Mayor's Fund application and
  make edits as needed.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  26-55321  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the Mayor’s Fund 2026
  Fundraising strategies.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

CHAIR ELECTION

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Mayor’s Fund Subcommittee on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to two minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Jennifer Santana, Community Program Specialist III, certify that the agenda was posted not less
than 72 hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Jennifer Santana at 562-570-4555 or
Jennifer.Santana@longbeach.gov.
